scope: Final read-only re-review of T4-R1 only against phase-two-task-4-context-fix-package.json.

fix_verdicts.evidence: review_candidate now materializes only the candidate sources authorized for the actor, derives source_specimens from their observations, and rejects a nonempty proposed specimen unless it exactly matches those nonempty source specimens. For PROJECT candidates under a contextual dictionary, proposed.match is called once per authorized source with item.observation.specimen; definition specimen/category values are no longer supplied as the validation context. Because schema 2.0 requires every indicator specimen to be nonempty, this covers v2 definitions, while the fully context-free schema 1.0 path continues to match without invented context. Reviewed rule specimens are also rejected when they differ from a nonempty authorized source specimen. The new focused test changes the authorized source to URINE and proves that a proposed BLOOD definition is rejected even when the candidate raw term is present as an alias.

code_quality.evidence: The context decision is explicit and conservative: v2 uses authorized source observations, v1 remains backward compatible, all accessible source matches must resolve to the reviewed code, and rules reuse the same source-derived specimen set. The focused mismatch test exercises the prior production failure mode.

known_integration_work_excluded: The complete extraction/evaluation regression gate is pending root integration.
apps.operations.services publication remains a legacy bypass pending root integration.

verification.reported_red: The authorized-source URINE versus proposed-definition BLOOD case failed before the fix.
verification.method: Read-only package, implementation, schema, and focused test inspection
